# Bhadraksh Bhargava — Freelance Software Engineer (MVPs, Microservices, AI)

> I help product teams ship testable MVPs fast, scale APIs to sub‑200ms p95, and infuse AI features that lift retention and revenue. Hyderabad‑based, open to remote. Limited to 2 client slots/month. 48‑hour technical audit included.

Decision‑ready facts:
- 4+ production apps shipped; 60% faster releases; 99.9% crash‑free mobile; 0 P1 incidents (18 months)
- Core stacks: Flutter, React/Next.js, React Native, Go/Gin, FastAPI, Python, Node.js
- Data/infra: PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL, RabbitMQ; Docker; GCP Cloud Run; CI/CD with GitHub Actions
- AI: LangChain, Vector DBs, Neo4j, prompt engineering; agent workflows and RAG

Services at a glance (from index.html):
- MVP Sprint (4 weeks): prioritized scope, working MVP, weekly Loom updates, release + handover
- Scale & Reliability (3–4 weeks): latency/bottleneck audit, CI/CD pipelines + rollback, performance goals
- AI Infusion (4–6 weeks): use‑case mapping, RAG + vector DB plan, analytics hooks, security/eval checklist

Selected results (from case studies):
- Vet Clinic Platform: event‑driven Go microservices on Cloud Run + RabbitMQ → 10× traffic, 0 downtime during promos
- E‑commerce API: optimized FastAPI + MySQL → p95 184ms, +18% checkout completion
- Google ADK contribution: real‑time agent graph visualization → debugging from hours to minutes

Risk and trust:
- Audit guarantee: if Scale & Reliability audit doesn’t uncover ≥20% p95 reduction opportunities, you don’t pay
- NDA available; 100% code and IP ownership remains with you
- Trial Sprint: 5‑day paid pilot with a clear Go/No‑Go; continue only if value is proven
- Milestone billing: pay per milestone with cancel‑anytime after a milestone—no lock‑in
- Transparent comms: weekly Loom demos + daily async updates; shared Kanban and metrics dashboard
- Security hygiene: no plaintext secrets; least‑privilege access; separate staging/prod; credential rotation
- Code ownership & IP: work happens in your org/repo; signed IP assignment; PR‑based workflow with reviews
- Documentation & handover: architecture diagram, runbooks, infra notes, READMEs, and dashboard links
- SLOs & rollback: explicit p95/p99 SLOs; canary/blue‑green releases; one‑click rollback playbooks
- Testing baseline: unit + integration smoke tests; CI gates; performance test plan where relevant
- Observability: structured logs, tracing, alerts, error budgets; on‑call friendly dashboards
- Privacy: PII minimization; anonymized dev datasets; data retention controls
- Warranty: 14‑day bug‑fix window post‑launch; severity‑based response targets
- References available on request; open‑source/code samples linked below

Ideal fit:
- MVP in 4 weeks: Flutter/React/Next.js + Go/Node/FastAPI with auth, payments, CRUD, and dashboards
- APIs with p95 <200ms: Postgres/MySQL tuning, caching, async jobs, and rollback‑safe releases
- Event‑driven microservices: Cloud Run + RabbitMQ, idempotent consumers, retries, DLQs
- Mobile apps with reliability goals: Flutter/React Native with crash‑free targets and OTA updates
- AI features tied to metrics: semantic search, RAG chat, classification; analytics hooks and evals
- Migration out of a brittle monolith: well‑scoped service boundaries, data migration plans, strangler patterns
- Cost + reliability work: right‑sizing, cold‑start reduction, cache strategy, perf budgets
- Growth/experimentation: analytics events, A/B tests, funnels; feature flags and safe launches
- Integration‑heavy projects: Stripe/PayPal, Twilio, SendGrid, Firebase/Auth, Google APIs, webhooks
- Data workflows: ETL jobs, scheduled reports, admin tooling, and audit logs
- Developer experience: CI/CD with GitHub Actions, linters/typechecks, pre‑commit, PR templates
